title: Purchase Option
description: One way to buy a variant: once, as a subscription, on pre-order. The Business enumerates the options it sells; the Platform selects one by `id`. An option states how the line it is selected on is bought — its price now and, through `schedules`, the recurring orders that follow — and never adds, removes, or changes other lines.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this option, sent back as `selected_purchase_option_id`. Stable for as long as the option is offered; a Platform treats it as indivisible and derives nothing from it.

title.description: Short label that distinguishes this option from its siblings (e.g. 'One-time', 'Subscribe & save 15%', 'Pre-order').

description.description: Supplementary buyer-facing context for the title (e.g. 'Cancel anytime', 'Ships in March'). Directly renderable; MUST NOT repeat the title.

price.description: What one unit costs in the current purchase under this option, after any discount or fixed pricing the option defines and before quantity, taxes, discounts, fees, and fulfillment. `0` means the current purchase is genuinely free; it never means a non-zero amount is merely collected later — a free trial is a first order at full price whose payment a payment term defers. Recurring orders are excluded; they are stated in `schedules`.

list_price.description: Reference price this option's `price` is a saving against, for strikethrough display and a derivable saving, mirroring `variant.list_price`: for a subscribe-and-save option, the one-time price. Absent when there is nothing to compare.

schedules.description: The recurring orders that follow the current purchase when this option is selected, as one or more consecutive schedules in the order they take effect; each continues until the next one's `starts_at`, and the last until the subscription ends, as its description states. Present only on an option that results in recurring orders; its presence is what makes the option a subscription. Indicative while the option is unselected, like an unselected payment term; binding for the selected option on a cart or checkout line, where a subscription policy and its disclosure accompany it.
